import loader = "./script_loader.qui"
import matcher = "./matcher.qui"

int code_order(string code)
    codes := ["SYNTAX", "ORPHAN", "DUPLICATE", "KEY_NO_DECOMP", "KEY_UNREACHABLE", "SYNON_UNUSED", "PRE_CHAIN", "SYNON_UNKNOWN", "RULE_NO_REASM", "RULE_SHADOWED", "REF_UNBOUND", "TARGET_UNDEFINED", "TARGET_CYCLE"]
    for: index < #codes
        if codes[index] == code
            return int(index)
    return -1

bool is_error(string code)
    return loader.has_word(["SYNTAX", "ORPHAN", "DUPLICATE", "SYNON_UNKNOWN", "REF_UNBOUND", "TARGET_UNDEFINED", "TARGET_CYCLE"], code)

bool moves(loader.Item item)
    return item.kind == "GOTO" or item.kind == "RESTATE"

string[] unknown_groups(string[] pattern, loader.Script script)
    string[] result := []
    for element := pattern[]
        if element.starts_with("@") and script.group_index(element[1:<#element]) < 0
            result = result.append(element[1:<#element])
    return result

int[] references(loader.Item item)
    int[] result := []
    if item.kind == "REASM"
        for: 0 <= index < int(#item.text) - 2
            if loader.is_reference(item.text[index:<index + 3])
                result = result.append(int(item.text[index + 1]))
    elif item.kind == "RESTATE"
        for: 1 <= index < int(#item.arguments)
            if loader.is_reference(item.arguments[index])
                result = result.append(int(item.arguments[index][1]))
    return result

bool reaches(int[][] graph, int start, int goal)
    pending := [start]
    seen := array(#graph, fill = false)
    while #pending != 0
        current := pending[-1]
        pending = pending[0:<#pending - 1]
        if current == goal
            return true
        if seen[current]
            continue
        seen[current] = true
        pending = pending.concat(graph[current])
    return false

loader.Diagnostic[] lint(loader.Script script)
    loader.Diagnostic[] found := script.diagnostics
    string[] replacements := []
    string[] pre_sources := []
    for entry := script.pres[]
        pre_sources = pre_sources.append(entry.source)
        replacements = replacements.concat(entry.replacement)
    string[] targets := []
    for item := script.items[]
        if moves(item)
            targets = targets.append(item.arguments[0])
    string[] used_groups := []
    for rule := script.rules[]
        for element := rule.pattern[]
            if element.starts_with("@")
                used_groups = used_groups.append(element[1:<#element])
    int[][] graph := []
    for keyword := script.keywords[]
        int[] edges := []
        for rule_id := keyword.decomps[]
            for item_id := script.rules[rule_id].items[]
                loader.Item item := script.items[item_id]
                if moves(item)
                    target := script.keyword_index(item.arguments[0])
                    if target >= 0
                        edges = edges.append(target)
        graph = graph.append(edges)
    for: keyword_id < #script.keywords
        loader.Keyword keyword := script.keywords[keyword_id]
        if #keyword.decomps == 0
            found = found.append(loader.Diagnostic(keyword.line, "KEY_NO_DECOMP", "keyword {keyword.word} has no DECOMP"))
        if loader.has_word(pre_sources, keyword.word) and not loader.has_word(replacements, keyword.word) and not loader.has_word(targets, keyword.word)
            found = found.append(loader.Diagnostic(keyword.line, "KEY_UNREACHABLE", "keyword {keyword.word} is replaced by PRE"))
        kinds := [keyword.memories, keyword.decomps]
        for rules := kinds[]
            for: position < #rules
                loader.Rule rule := script.rules[rules[position]]
                unknown := unknown_groups(rule.pattern, script)
                for name := unknown[]
                    found = found.append(loader.Diagnostic(rule.line, "SYNON_UNKNOWN", "unknown group {name}"))
                if #rule.items == 0
                    found = found.append(loader.Diagnostic(rule.line, "RULE_NO_REASM", "rule has no reassembly"))
                if #unknown == 0
                    for: earlier < position
                        loader.Rule previous := script.rules[rules[earlier]]
                        if #unknown_groups(previous.pattern, script) == 0 and matcher.pattern_covers(previous.pattern, rule.pattern, script)
                            found = found.append(loader.Diagnostic(rule.line, "RULE_SHADOWED", "pattern is shadowed by line {previous.line}"))
                            break
                wildcards := 0
                for element := rule.pattern[]
                    if matcher.is_wildcard(element)
                        wildcards += 1
                for item_id := rule.items[]
                    loader.Item item := script.items[item_id]
                    for number := references(item)[]
                        if number == 0 or number > wildcards
                            found = found.append(loader.Diagnostic(item.line, "REF_UNBOUND", "reference ({number}) is not bound"))
                    if moves(item)
                        word := item.arguments[0]
                        target := script.keyword_index(word)
                        if target < 0
                            found = found.append(loader.Diagnostic(item.line, "TARGET_UNDEFINED", "target {word} is not a keyword"))
                        elif reaches(graph, target, int(keyword_id))
                            found = found.append(loader.Diagnostic(item.line, "TARGET_CYCLE", "edge {keyword.word} -> {word} is on a cycle"))
    for group := script.groups[]
        if not loader.has_word(used_groups, group.name)
            found = found.append(loader.Diagnostic(group.line, "SYNON_UNUSED", "group {group.name} is never used"))
    for entry := script.pres[]
        for word := entry.replacement[]
            if loader.has_word(pre_sources, word)
                found = found.append(loader.Diagnostic(entry.line, "PRE_CHAIN", "replacement {word} is itself replaced by PRE"))
    for: 1 <= index < int(#found)
        current := found[index]
        cursor := index
        while cursor > 0
            previous := found[cursor - 1]
            if previous.line < current.line or (previous.line == current.line and code_order(previous.code) <= code_order(current.code))
                break
            found[cursor] = previous
            cursor -= 1
        found[cursor] = current
    return found

string[] lint_lines(loader.Diagnostic[] diagnostics)
    if #diagnostics == 0
        return ["OK"]
    string[] result := []
    errors := 0
    for diagnostic := diagnostics[]
        result = result.append("{diagnostic.line} {diagnostic.code} {diagnostic.message}")
        if is_error(diagnostic.code)
            errors += 1
    return result.append("TOTAL {#diagnostics} errors={errors} warnings={int(#diagnostics) - errors}")

import loader = "./script_loader.qui"
import linter = "./linter.qui"
import matcher = "./matcher.qui"
import responder = "./responder.qui"
import memory = "./memory.qui"

string[] normalized_part(string text)
    cleaned := ""
    for: index < #text
        character := text[index]
        cleaned += if "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'".contains(character) then character else " "
    string[] result := []
    for token := cleaned.split(" ")[]
        word := token
        while #word > 0 and word[0] == "'"
            word = word[1:<#word]
        while #word > 0 and word[#word - 1] == "'"
            word = word[0:<#word - 1]
        if word != ""
            result = result.append(word)
    return result

string[][] normalize(string text)
    string[][] result := []
    part := ""
    for: index < #text
        character := text[index]
        int[] codes := character.codepoints()
        if 65 <= codes[0] <= 90
            character = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"[codes[0] - 65]
        if ",.?!;".contains(character)
            words := normalized_part(part)
            if #words > 0
                result = result.append(words)
            part = ""
        else
            part += character
    words := normalized_part(part)
    if #words > 0
        result = result.append(words)
    return result

string[] flatten(string[][] clauses)
    string[] result := []
    for clause := clauses[]
        result = result.concat(clause)
    return result

string[][] prepare(string text, loader.Script script)
    string[][] result := []
    for clause := normalize(text)[]
        result = result.append(script.substitute(clause, false))
    return result

bool is_quit(string text, loader.Script script)
    words := flatten(normalize(text))
    return #words == 1 and loader.has_word(script.quit_words, words[0])

bool has_id(int[] ids, int target)
    for id := ids[]
        if id == target
            return true
    return false

class Selection(number := 0, string[] words := [], int[] keywords := [])

Selection select_clause(string[][] clauses, loader.Script script)
    for: clause_index < #clauses
        int[] ids := []
        for word := clauses[clause_index][]
            id := script.keyword_index(word)
            if id >= 0 and not has_id(ids, id)
                ids = ids.append(id)
        if #ids == 0
            continue
        for: 1 <= offset < int(#ids)
            current := ids[offset]
            cursor := offset
            while cursor > 0 and script.keywords[ids[cursor - 1]].rank < script.keywords[current].rank
                ids[cursor] = ids[cursor - 1]
                cursor -= 1
            ids[cursor] = current
        return Selection(int(clause_index) + 1, clauses[clause_index], ids)
    return Selection()

int map_count(map<string, int> counts, string word)
    match counts.get(word)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return 0

void increment(map<string, int> &counts, string word)
    .counts.set(word, map_count(counts, word) + 1)

string number_list(int[] numbers, separator := " ")
    string[] parts := []
    for number := numbers[]
        parts = parts.append(string(number))
    return parts.join(separator)

string[] grouped_lines(string[] values, int width)
    string[] result := []
    for: 0 <= start < int(#values) step width
        finish := if start + width < int(#values) then start + width else int(#values)
        result = result.append(values[start:<finish].join(" "))
    return result

string ranked_counts(map<string, int> counts)
    names := counts.keys().sorted()
    frequencies := [for name := names[] then map_count(counts, name)]
    names = names.sorted(by = frequencies, descending = true)
    string[] result := []
    for: index < #names
        if index == 5
            break
        result = result.append("{names[index]} {map_count(counts, names[index])}")
    return if #result == 0 then "none" else result.join(", ")

string source_line(int turns, int[] sources)
    return "turns={turns} keyword={sources[0]} memory={sources[1]} question={sources[2]} default={sources[3]} repeat={sources[4]}"

class Session(string name)
    turns := 0
    sources := array(5, fill = 0)
    string[][] previous := []
    has_previous := false
    string[] history := []
    string[] last_trace := []
    trace_on := false
    topics := map<string, int>()
    words := map<string, int>()
    stored := 0
    recalled := 0
    int[] unrecognized := []

class State(local loader.Script source)
    positions := array(#source.rules, fill = 0)
    hits := array(#source.rules, fill = 0)
    item_uses := array(#source.items, fill = 0)
    keyword_uses := array(#source.keywords, fill = 0)
    keyword_replies := array(#source.keywords, fill = 0)
    list_positions := array(3, fill = 0)
    queue := memory.MemoryQueue(source.memsize)
    session := Session("")

class Taken(int number, int item)

class Reply(string text, string[] trace)

class RuleEntry(string kind, int number, int id)

RuleEntry[] rule_entries(loader.Keyword keyword)
    RuleEntry[] result := []
    for: index < #keyword.memories
        result = result.append(RuleEntry("memory", int(index) + 1, keyword.memories[index]))
    for: index < #keyword.decomps
        result = result.append(RuleEntry("decomp", int(index) + 1, keyword.decomps[index]))
    return result

class Chatbot(loader.Script script)
    state := State(script)
    State saved := state
    undo_available := false
    string[] transcript := []
    sessions := 0
    total_turns := 0
    total_sources := array(5, fill = 0)

    string prefix()
        return "{state.session.name} {state.session.turns}"

    void .cycle_reset()
        state.positions = array(#script.rules, fill = 0)
        state.list_positions = array(3, fill = 0)

    string .take_text(string kind)
        index := if kind == "DEFAULT" then 0 elif kind == "QUESTION" then 1 else 2
        texts := script.text_list(kind)
        int position := state.list_positions[index]
        state.list_positions[index] = (position + 1) % int(#texts)
        return texts[position]

    Taken .take_item(int rule_id)
        loader.Rule rule := script.rules[rule_id]
        int position := state.positions[rule_id]
        item := rule.items[position]
        state.positions[rule_id] = (position + 1) % int(#rule.items)
        state.item_uses[item] += 1
        return Taken(position + 1, item)

    string .keyword_reply(string[][] clauses, string[] &trace)
        selected := select_clause(clauses, script)
        if selected.number == 0
            trace = trace.append("CLAUSE none")
            return ""
        trace = trace.append("CLAUSE {selected.number} {selected.words.join(" ")}")
        string[] names := []
        for id := selected.keywords[]
            names = names.append(script.keywords[id].word)
        trace = trace.append("KEYS " + names.join(" "))
        loader.Keyword first := script.keywords[selected.keywords[0]]
        for: offset < #first.memories
            rule_id := first.memories[offset]
            loader.Rule rule := script.rules[rule_id]
            matched := matcher.match_pattern(rule.pattern, selected.words, script)
            if not matched.found
                continue
            trace = trace.append("MEMORY {first.word} {offset + 1}")
            state.hits[rule_id] += 1
            if #rule.items > 0
                Taken taken := .take_item(rule_id)
                text := responder.build_reply(script.items[taken.item].text, matched.bindings, script)
                if .state.queue.store(prefix(), first.word, text)
                    state.session.stored += 1
            break
        entered := array(#script.keywords, fill = false)
        for initial := selected.keywords[]
            if entered[initial]
                continue
            current := initial
            words := selected.words
            trace = trace.append("ENTER {script.keywords[current].word}")
            while true
                entered[current] = true
                state.keyword_uses[current] += 1
                loader.Keyword keyword := script.keywords[current]
                rule_id := -1
                rule_number := 0
                matched := matcher.MatchResult(false)
                for: offset < #keyword.decomps
                    candidate := keyword.decomps[offset]
                    matched = matcher.match_pattern(script.rules[candidate].pattern, words, script)
                    if matched.found
                        rule_id = candidate
                        rule_number = int(offset) + 1
                        break
                if rule_id < 0
                    trace = trace.append("NOMATCH {keyword.word}")
                    break
                state.hits[rule_id] += 1
                if #script.rules[rule_id].items == 0
                    trace = trace.append("DECOMP {keyword.word} {rule_number} 0")
                    break
                Taken taken := .take_item(rule_id)
                loader.Item item := script.items[taken.item]
                trace = trace.append("DECOMP {keyword.word} {rule_number} {taken.number}")
                if item.kind == "REASM"
                    state.keyword_replies[current] += 1
                    increment(&state.session.topics, keyword.word)
                    return responder.build_reply(item.text, matched.bindings, script)
                if item.kind == "NEWKEY"
                    break
                target_word := item.arguments[0]
                target := script.keyword_index(target_word)
                if target < 0 or entered[target]
                    trace = trace.append("BLOCKED {target_word}")
                    break
                if item.kind == "RESTATE"
                    words = responder.restated_words(item.arguments[1:<#item.arguments], matched.bindings)
                    trace = trace.append("RESTATE {target_word}" + (if #words == 0 then "" else " " + words.join(" ")))
                else
                    trace = trace.append("GOTO {target_word}")
                current = target
        return ""

    Reply .respond(string text)
        clauses := normalize(text)
        string[] trace := []
        answer := ""
        source := 0
        if #script.text_list("REPEAT") > 0 and #clauses > 0 and state.session.has_previous and clauses == state.session.previous
            trace = ["REPEAT"]
            answer = .take_text("REPEAT")
            source = 4
        else
            answer = .keyword_reply(prepare(text, script), &trace)
            if answer == ""
                if #state.queue.texts > 0
                    answer = .state.queue.recall(prefix())
                    state.session.recalled += 1
                    source = 1
                elif text.ends_with("?") and #script.text_list("QUESTION") > 0
                    answer = .take_text("QUESTION")
                    source = 2
                else
                    answer = .take_text("DEFAULT")
                    source = 3
        sources := ["keyword", "memory", "question", "default", "repeat"]
        trace = trace.append("REPLY {sources[source]}")
        state.session.previous = clauses
        state.session.has_previous = true
        state.session.sources[source] += 1
        if source == 2 or source == 3
            state.session.unrecognized = state.session.unrecognized.append(state.session.turns)
        return Reply(answer, trace)

    void .start_session(string name)
        if sessions > 0
            transcript = transcript.append("")
        if not loader.has_word(script.persist, "cycles")
            .cycle_reset()
        if not loader.has_word(script.persist, "memory")
            .state.queue.clear(name + " 0")
        state.session = Session(name)
        undo_available = false
        sessions += 1
        transcript = transcript.append("SESSION {name}")
        initial := script.text_list("INITIAL")
        transcript = transcript.concat(responder.eliza_lines(initial[(sessions - 1) % int(#initial)]))

    void .end_session()
        Session current := state.session
        missing := if #current.unrecognized == 0 then "none" else number_list(current.unrecognized)
        transcript = transcript.concat(["NOTES {current.name}", "  " + source_line(current.turns, current.sources), "  topics: " + ranked_counts(current.topics), "  words: " + ranked_counts(current.words), "  memory: stored={current.stored} recalled={current.recalled} pending={#state.queue.texts}", "  unrecognized: " + missing])
        total_turns += current.turns
        for: index < #total_sources
            total_sources[index] += current.sources[index]

    void .utterance(string text)
        transcript = transcript.append("YOU: " + text)
        if is_quit(text, script)
            finals := script.text_list("FINAL")
            transcript = transcript.concat(responder.eliza_lines(finals[(sessions - 1) % int(#finals)]))
            .end_session()
            return
        saved = state
        undo_available = true
        state.session.turns += 1
        for word := flatten(normalize(text))[]
            if not loader.has_word(script.stop_words, word)
                increment(&state.session.words, word)
        state.session.history = state.session.history.append("{state.session.turns}: {text}")
        Reply answer := .respond(text)
        state.session.last_trace = answer.trace
        transcript = transcript.concat(responder.eliza_lines(answer.text))
        if state.session.trace_on
            for line := answer.trace[]
                transcript = transcript.append("  " + line)

    int criterion(int id, bool usage)
        return if usage then state.keyword_uses[id] else script.keywords[id].rank

    int[] ordered_keywords(bool usage)
        string[] names := []
        for keyword := script.keywords[]
            names = names.append(keyword.word)
        names = names.sorted()
        int[] ids := []
        for word := names[]
            ids = ids.append(script.keyword_index(word))
        for: 1 <= offset < int(#ids)
            current := ids[offset]
            cursor := offset
            while cursor > 0 and criterion(ids[cursor - 1], usage) < criterion(current, usage)
                ids[cursor] = ids[cursor - 1]
                cursor -= 1
            ids[cursor] = current
        return ids

    string[] inspect_find(string word)
        string[] result := []
        keyword_id := script.keyword_index(word)
        if keyword_id >= 0
            result = result.append("keyword rank {script.keywords[keyword_id].rank}")
        for entry := script.pres[]
            if entry.source == word or loader.has_word(entry.replacement, word)
                result = result.append("pre {entry.line}: {entry.source} -> {entry.replacement.join(" ")}")
        for entry := script.posts[]
            if entry.source == word or loader.has_word(entry.replacement, word)
                result = result.append("post {entry.line}: {entry.source} -> {entry.replacement.join(" ")}")
        for group := script.groups[]
            if loader.has_word(group.members, word)
                result = result.append("group {group.name} line {group.line}")
        for keyword := script.keywords[]
            for entry := rule_entries(keyword)[]
                if loader.has_word(script.rules[entry.id].pattern, word)
                    result = result.append("pattern {keyword.word} {entry.kind} {entry.number}")
        if loader.has_word(script.stop_words, word)
            result = result.append("stop word")
        if loader.has_word(script.quit_words, word)
            result = result.append("quit word")
        return if #result == 0 then ["not found"] else result

    string[] inspect_rules(int keyword_id, bool coverage)
        string[] result := []
        for entry := rule_entries(script.keywords[keyword_id])[]
            loader.Rule rule := script.rules[entry.id]
            header := "{entry.kind} {entry.number}: "
            if coverage
                int[] uses := []
                for item_id := rule.items[]
                    uses = uses.append(state.item_uses[item_id])
                counts := if #uses == 0 then "-" else number_list(uses)
                result = result.append(header + "hits {state.hits[entry.id]} entries {counts}")
            elif #rule.items == 0
                result = result.append(header + "empty")
            else
                result = result.append(header + "next {state.positions[entry.id] + 1}/{#rule.items}")
        return if #result == 0 then ["no rules"] else result

    string[] .command(string line)
        words := line.split(" ")
        name := words[0]
        arguments := words[1:<#words]
        text := arguments.join(" ")
        no_arguments := [":keys", ":why", ":history", ":memory", ":forget", ":reset", ":unused", ":stats", ":undo"]
        text_commands := [":prepare", ":reflect", ":say", ":explain"]
        single := [":groups", ":find", ":script", ":cycles", ":coverage"]
        string[] known := no_arguments.concat(text_commands).concat(single).concat([":trace", ":test"])
        if not loader.has_word(known, name)
            return ["unknown command {name}"]
        count := int(#arguments)
        if (loader.has_word(no_arguments, name) and count != 0) or (loader.has_word(text_commands, name) and text == "") or (loader.has_word(single, name) and count != 1)
            return ["bad arguments"]
        if name == ":trace" and (count != 1 or not loader.has_word(["on", "off"], arguments[0]))
            return ["bad arguments"]
        if name == ":test" and count < 2
            return ["bad arguments"]
        keyword_id := -1
        if loader.has_word([":script", ":cycles", ":coverage", ":test"], name)
            keyword_id = script.keyword_index(arguments[0])
            if keyword_id < 0
                return ["unknown keyword {arguments[0]}"]
        if name == ":prepare"
            clauses := prepare(text, script)
            string[] result := []
            for: index < #clauses
                result = result.append("clause {index + 1}: {clauses[index].join(" ")}")
            if #clauses == 0
                result = ["no words"]
            selected := select_clause(clauses, script)
            if selected.number == 0
                return result.append("selected none")
            string[] keys := []
            for id := selected.keywords[]
                keys = keys.append("{script.keywords[id].word}/{script.keywords[id].rank}")
            return result.concat(["selected {selected.number}", "keys " + keys.join(" ")])
        if name == ":test"
            uttered := flatten(prepare(arguments[1:<#arguments].join(" "), script))
            string[] result := []
            for entry := rule_entries(script.keywords[keyword_id])[]
                matched := matcher.match_pattern(script.rules[entry.id].pattern, uttered, script)
                description := "no match"
                if matched.found
                    description = "match"
                    if #matched.bindings > 0
                        string[] bindings := []
                        for bound := matched.bindings[]
                            bindings = bindings.append("[" + bound.join(" ") + "]")
                        description = bindings.join(" ")
                result = result.append("{entry.kind} {entry.number}: {description}")
            return if #result == 0 then ["no rules"] else result
        if name == ":reflect"
            string[] result := []
            for clause := prepare(text, script)[]
                result = result.append(script.substitute(clause, true).join(" "))
            return if #result == 0 then ["no words"] else result
        if name == ":keys"
            string[] keys := []
            for id := ordered_keywords(false)[]
                keys = keys.append("{script.keywords[id].word}/{script.keywords[id].rank}")
            return grouped_lines(keys, 8)
        if name == ":groups"
            string[] names := []
            for group := script.groups[]
                if loader.has_word(group.members, arguments[0])
                    names = names.append(group.name)
            return [if #names == 0 then "none" else names.sorted().join(" ")]
        if name == ":find"
            return inspect_find(arguments[0])
        if name == ":script"
            int[] numbers := [script.keywords[keyword_id].line]
            for entry := rule_entries(script.keywords[keyword_id])[]
                loader.Rule rule := script.rules[entry.id]
                numbers = numbers.append(rule.line)
                for item_id := rule.items[]
                    numbers = numbers.append(script.items[item_id].line)
            string[] result := []
            for number := numbers.sorted()[]
                result = result.append("{number} {script.lines[number - 1]}")
            return result
        if name == ":why"
            return if #state.session.last_trace == 0 then ["no reply yet"] else state.session.last_trace
        if name == ":trace"
            state.session.trace_on = arguments[0] == "on"
            return ["trace {arguments[0]}"]
        if name == ":history"
            start := if #state.session.history > 5 then int(#state.session.history) - 5 else 0
            return if #state.session.history == 0 then ["no turns yet"] else state.session.history[start:<#state.session.history]
        if name == ":memory"
            result := ["memory {#state.queue.texts}/{state.queue.capacity}"]
            for: index < #state.queue.texts
                result = result.append("{index + 1}: {state.queue.texts[index]}")
            return result
        if name == ":forget"
            previous := int(#state.queue.texts)
            .state.queue.clear(prefix())
            return ["forgot {previous}"]
        if name == ":cycles" or name == ":coverage"
            return inspect_rules(keyword_id, name == ":coverage")
        if name == ":reset"
            .cycle_reset()
            return ["cycles reset"]
        if name == ":unused"
            int[] unused := []
            for: index < #script.items
                if state.item_uses[index] == 0
                    unused = unused.append(script.items[index].line)
            string[] values := []
            for number := unused.sorted()[]
                values = values.append(string(number))
            return ["unused {#unused}"].concat(grouped_lines(values, 12))
        if name == ":stats"
            return [source_line(state.session.turns, state.session.sources)]
        if name == ":undo"
            if not undo_available
                return ["nothing to undo"]
            state = saved
            undo_available = false
            return ["undone turn {state.session.turns + 1}"]
        if is_quit(text, script)
            return ["would quit"]
        State before := state
        Reply answer := .respond(text)
        state = before
        return if name == ":say" then [answer.text] else answer.trace

    void .run_command(string line)
        transcript = transcript.append(line)
        string[] result := .command(line)
        for output := result[]
            transcript = transcript.append("  " + output)

    string[] keyword_stats()
        result := ["keyword,rank,uses,replies,decomposition_hits"]
        for id := ordered_keywords(true)[]
            loader.Keyword keyword := script.keywords[id]
            int[] hits := []
            for rule_id := keyword.decomps[]
                hits = hits.append(state.hits[rule_id])
            counts := if #hits == 0 then "-" else number_list(hits, "/")
            result = result.append("{keyword.word},{keyword.rank},{state.keyword_uses[id]},{state.keyword_replies[id]},{counts}")
        return result

    void .finish()
        transcript = transcript.concat(["", "SUMMARY sessions={sessions} " + source_line(total_turns, total_sources)])

void write_lines(string path, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write(path)
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)

class MemoryQueue(int capacity)
    string[] texts := []
    string[] log := []

    bool .store(string prefix, string keyword, string text)
        for previous := texts[]
            if previous == text
                log = log.append("{prefix} SKIP {keyword} {text}")
                return false
        if int(#texts) == capacity
            log = log.append("{prefix} DROP {texts[0]}")
            texts = texts[1:<#texts]
        texts = texts.append(text)
        log = log.append("{prefix} STORE {keyword} {text}")
        return true

    string .recall(string prefix)
        text := texts[0]
        texts = texts[1:<#texts]
        log = log.append("{prefix} RECALL {text}")
        return text

    void .clear(string prefix)
        if #texts > 0
            log = log.append("{prefix} CLEAR {#texts}")
            texts = []

import loader = "./script_loader.qui"

string[] binding(string[][] bindings, int number)
    return if 1 <= number <= int(#bindings) then bindings[number - 1] else []

string build_reply(string template, string[][] bindings, loader.Script script)
    text := ""
    position := 0
    while position < int(#template)
        if position + 3 <= int(#template) and loader.is_reference(template[position:<position + 3])
            text += script.substitute(binding(bindings, int(template[position + 1])), true).join(" ")
            position += 3
        else
            text += template[position]
            position += 1
    string[] words := []
    for word := text.split(" ")[]
        if word != ""
            words = words.append(word)
    text = words.join(" ")
    if #text > 0
        for: 0 <= index < 26
            if text[0] == "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"[index]
                text = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"[index] + text[1:<#text]
                break
    return text

string[] restated_words(string[] arguments, string[][] bindings)
    string[] result := []
    for argument := arguments[]
        if loader.is_reference(argument)
            result = result.concat(binding(bindings, int(argument[1])))
        else
            result = result.append(argument)
    return result

string[] eliza_lines(string text)
    string[] words := []
    for word := text.split(" ")[]
        if word != ""
            words = words.append(word)
    string[] result := []
    line := "ELIZA:"
    for word := words[]
        if #result == 0 and line == "ELIZA:"
            line += " " + word
        elif #line + 1 + #word <= 72
            line += " " + word
        else
            result = result.append(line)
            line = "       " + word
    return result.append(line)

bool has_word(string[] words, string target)
    for word := words[]
        if word == target
            return true
    return false

bool is_word(string text)
    if #text == 0 or text[0] == "'" or text[#text - 1] == "'"
        return false
    for: index < #text
        if not "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'".contains(text[index])
            return false
    return true

bool is_number(string text)
    if #text < 1 or #text > 2
        return false
    for: index < #text
        if not "0123456789".contains(text[index])
            return false
    return true

bool is_reference(string text)
    return #text == 3 and text[0] == "(" and "0123456789".contains(text[1]) and text[2] == ")"

bool is_element(string text)
    if text == "*" or text == "#"
        return true
    if text.starts_with("@")
        return is_word(text[1:<#text])
    return is_word(text)

bool all_words(string[] words)
    for word := words[]
        if not is_word(word)
            return false
    return true

bool well_formed(string name, string[] arguments)
    count := int(#arguments)
    if has_word(["INITIAL", "FINAL", "DEFAULT", "QUESTION", "REPEAT", "REASM"], name)
        return count >= 1
    if name == "QUIT" or name == "STOP"
        return count >= 1 and all_words(arguments)
    if name == "MEMSIZE"
        return count == 1 and is_number(arguments[0]) and 1 <= int(arguments[0]) <= 20
    if name == "PERSIST"
        return count == 1 and has_word(["cycles", "memory"], arguments[0])
    if name == "PRE" or name == "SYNON"
        return count >= 2 and all_words(arguments)
    if name == "POST"
        return count >= 2 and is_word(arguments[0])
    if name == "KEY"
        return count == 2 and is_word(arguments[0]) and is_number(arguments[1])
    if name == "DECOMP" or name == "MEMORY"
        if count == 0
            return false
        for argument := arguments[]
            if not is_element(argument)
                return false
        return true
    if name == "GOTO"
        return count == 1 and is_word(arguments[0])
    if name == "NEWKEY"
        return count == 0
    if count < 2 or not is_word(arguments[0])
        return false
    for: 1 <= index < count
        if not is_word(arguments[index]) and not is_reference(arguments[index])
            return false
    return true

class Diagnostic(int line, string code, string message)

class Substitution(string source, string[] replacement, int line)

class Group(string name, string[] members, int line)

class Item(string kind, string text, string[] arguments, int line)

class Rule(string kind, string[] pattern, int line)
    int[] items := []

class Keyword(string word, int rank, int line)
    int[] memories := []
    int[] decomps := []

class Script(string[] lines)
    texts := map<string, string[]>()
    string[] quit_words := []
    string[] stop_words := []
    memsize := 3
    string[] persist := []
    Substitution[] pres := []
    Substitution[] posts := []
    Group[] groups := []
    Keyword[] keywords := []
    Rule[] rules := []
    Item[] items := []
    Diagnostic[] diagnostics := []

    string[] text_list(string name)
        match texts.get(name)
            string[] values
                return values
            none
                return []

    int keyword_index(string word)
        for: index < #keywords
            if keywords[index].word == word
                return int(index)
        return -1

    int group_index(string name)
        for: index < #groups
            if groups[index].name == name
                return int(index)
        return -1

    string[] group_words(string name)
        int index := group_index(name)
        return if index < 0 then [] else groups[index].members

    string[] substitute(string[] words, bool reflection)
        table := if reflection then posts else pres
        string[] result := []
        for word := words[]
            found := false
            for entry := table[]
                if entry.source == word
                    result = result.concat(entry.replacement)
                    found = true
                    break
            if not found
                result = result.append(word)
        return result

string definition_key(string name, string[] arguments)
    if name == "MEMSIZE"
        return name
    if has_word(["KEY", "SYNON", "PRE", "POST", "PERSIST"], name)
        return name + " " + arguments[0]
    return ""

Script load_script()
    string source := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/script.txt"))
    lines := source.split(NL)
    lines = lines[0:<#lines - 1]
    result := Script(lines)
    map<string, int> first_lines
    keyword := -1
    rule := -1
    ignoring := false
    globals := ["INITIAL", "FINAL", "QUIT", "STOP", "DEFAULT", "QUESTION", "REPEAT", "MEMSIZE", "PERSIST", "PRE", "POST", "SYNON"]
    string[] known := globals.concat(["KEY", "DECOMP", "MEMORY", "REASM", "GOTO", "NEWKEY", "RESTATE"])
    for: offset < #lines
        line := lines[offset]
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        words := line.split(" ")
        name := words[0]
        arguments := words[1:<#words]
        text := arguments.join(" ")
        number := int(offset) + 1
        rule_line := name == "DECOMP" or name == "MEMORY"
        item_line := has_word(["REASM", "GOTO", "NEWKEY", "RESTATE"], name)
        if has_word(globals, name) or name == "KEY"
            keyword = -1
            rule = -1
            ignoring = false
        elif rule_line or item_line
            if ignoring
                continue
            if rule_line
                rule = -1
        code := ""
        message := ""
        unique := ""
        if not has_word(known, name)
            code = "SYNTAX"
            message = "unknown directive {name}"
        elif not well_formed(name, arguments)
            code = "SYNTAX"
            message = "bad arguments for {name}"
        elif rule_line and keyword < 0
            code = "ORPHAN"
            message = "{name} without KEY"
        elif name == "REASM" and rule < 0
            code = "ORPHAN"
            message = "REASM without DECOMP or MEMORY"
        elif has_word(["GOTO", "NEWKEY", "RESTATE"], name) and (rule < 0 or result.rules[rule].kind == "MEMORY")
            code = "ORPHAN"
            message = "{name} without DECOMP"
        else
            unique = definition_key(name, arguments)
            if unique != ""
                match first_lines.get(unique)
                    int first
                        code = "DUPLICATE"
                        message = "{unique} first defined at line {first}"
                    none
                        message = ""
        if code != ""
            result.diagnostics = result.diagnostics.append(Diagnostic(number, code, message))
            if code == "DUPLICATE" and name == "KEY"
                ignoring = true
            continue
        if unique != ""
            .first_lines.set(unique, number)
        if has_word(["INITIAL", "FINAL", "DEFAULT", "QUESTION", "REPEAT"], name)
            .result.texts.set(name, result.text_list(name).append(text))
        elif name == "QUIT"
            result.quit_words = result.quit_words.concat(arguments)
        elif name == "STOP"
            result.stop_words = result.stop_words.concat(arguments)
        elif name == "MEMSIZE"
            result.memsize = int(arguments[0])
        elif name == "PERSIST"
            result.persist = result.persist.append(arguments[0])
        elif name == "PRE"
            result.pres = result.pres.append(Substitution(arguments[0], arguments[1:<#arguments], number))
        elif name == "POST"
            result.posts = result.posts.append(Substitution(arguments[0], arguments[1:<#arguments], number))
        elif name == "SYNON"
            result.groups = result.groups.append(Group(arguments[0], arguments, number))
        elif name == "KEY"
            keyword = int(#result.keywords)
            result.keywords = result.keywords.append(Keyword(arguments[0], int(arguments[1]), number))
        elif rule_line
            rule = int(#result.rules)
            result.rules = result.rules.append(Rule(name, arguments, number))
            if name == "MEMORY"
                result.keywords[keyword].memories = result.keywords[keyword].memories.append(rule)
            else
                result.keywords[keyword].decomps = result.keywords[keyword].decomps.append(rule)
        else
            item := int(#result.items)
            result.items = result.items.append(Item(name, text, arguments, number))
            result.rules[rule].items = result.rules[rule].items.append(item)
    return result
